description: Observed price series for an AliExpress product. Accepts the itemId or the product URL. Also returns the number of readings and days of tracking: with too little tracking there is no basis to claim a drop, and the response says so explicitly. `queda` is the latest drop (last 30 days) with when we detected it and the last reading that confirmed it (ISO 8601, UTC); null without a drop.

idioma.description: Optional language for the human-readable text (title, discount.explanation, discount.warning, pageUrl): "en" (default), "de", "pt", "es", "fr", "ko", "it" or "pl". Field names, numbers and currency (USD) are the same in every language.

produto.description: Numeric AliExpress product_id, or the product URL (https://www.aliexpress.com/item/<product_id>.html).

name: historico_de_preco
title: Price history for a product
